title: tev1-rank top.json
description: The ranked, selected segments handed to stage 2. Deterministic: no timestamps; identical inputs, model, config and cache state give byte-identical files.

mode.description: "no-model" means ranking used only the counts derived from the upstream annotations; kind and model are null.

source.description: The document the upstream text-preparation tool segmented, and the segments file this run read.

file.description: Name of the source document, as reported by the upstream tool (e.g. main.md).

format.description: Format of the source document, as reported by the upstream tool (e.g. md).

segments_hash.description: sha256 of the whole segments file that was read.

model.description: Ollama model tag, or null in no-model mode.

question_set_hash.description: sha256 over model + questions + state format, or null in no-model mode.

block.description: Ordinal of the source block, as numbered by the upstream tool.

block_kind.description: Structural kind from the upstream tool: heading, paragraph, blockquote, list_item, ... Not the tev1 kind.

section.description: Heading path of the segment, outermost first.

start.description: Byte offset into the SOURCE document (source.file), not into the segments file.

end.description: Exclusive byte offset into the source document.

text.description: The segment's plain text (markup stripped): what the model saw.

kind.description: Most likely kind; null in no-model mode.

features.description: Counts derived from the upstream annotations.

numerics.description: Tokens the upstream tagger marked CD.

entities.description: Named-entity spans found by the upstream tool.

words.description: Tokens containing a letter or digit.

position.description: Segment start as a fraction of the source document's extent.

model.description: Compact model answers; null in no-model mode.

importance.description: Expected importance on the configured scale, 1..N (1..5 by default).

confidence.description: Lowest model-reported confidence among ranking.review.confidence_questions (default: is_datapoint only), if reported.
